descriptor: A tool to help instructors identify students who are falling behind by analyzing portal activity, build progress, and attendance, and providing a weekly report with recommendations.

requirements.statement: The system must analyze student portal login activity to identify inactivity.
The system must analyze student build progress to identify lack of progress.
The system must analyze attendance records to identify missed live sessions.
The system must generate a weekly report every Monday morning for each instructor.
The system must include a list of three or four students in the weekly report who may need attention.
The system must suggest an opening line for each student listed in the report.
The system must allow instructors to review and approve the list before sending recommendations.
The system must flag students for instructor review if unsure about recommending them.
The system must integrate with the Student Portal to read login data.
The system must integrate with the Learning Management System to read build progress data.
The system must integrate with the Attendance Tracking System to read attendance data.
The system must integrate with the Email Platform to send reports.
The system must ensure data accuracy and consistency across all integrations.
Every instructor interface must allow review of recommendations in three clicks or fewer.
The system must handle exceptions where data is incomplete or unavailable.
The system must log all actions taken for audit purposes.
The system must operate with a response time that does not exceed 5 seconds for any user action.
The system must provide clear error messages to users when issues occur.

stories.title: User Login via Student Portal
stories.narrative: As a student, I want to log in via the Student Portal, so that I can access my data securely.
acceptance: Given a student with valid credentials, when they log in, then they should access their dashboard.
Given a student with invalid credentials, when they attempt to log in, then they should see an error message.
Trust: All login attempts must be logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Use the Student Portal API to authenticate users and log all login attempts in the audit log.

stories.title: Display Student Progress from LMS
stories.narrative: As an instructor, I want to view student progress from the LMS, so that I can monitor their learning journey.
acceptance: Given a student enrolled in a course, when the instructor views the progress, then the correct data should be displayed.
Given a student not enrolled in any course, when the instructor views the progress, then a 'no data available' message should be shown.
Trust: All data retrieval actions must be logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Integrate with the LMS API to fetch and display student progress data, ensuring data consistency.

stories.title: Track Attendance via Attendance System
stories.narrative: As an instructor, I want to track student attendance, so that I can ensure students are attending classes.
acceptance: Given a student attends a class, when the instructor checks attendance, then the attendance should be marked as present.
Given a student misses a class, when the instructor checks attendance, then the attendance should be marked as absent.
Trust: All attendance records must be logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Integrate with the Attendance Tracking System to fetch and log attendance data.

stories.title: Generate Basic Weekly Report
stories.narrative: As an instructor, I want to receive a basic weekly report, so that I can see which students are inactive.
acceptance: Given the system has collected data, when it is Monday morning, then a basic report is generated.
Given a student is identified as inactive, when the report is generated, then the student appears on the report.
Trust: All report generations are logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Create a report generation module that compiles data from all sources into a weekly report.

stories.title: Analyze Combined Data Signals
stories.narrative: As an instructor, I want the system to analyze combined data signals, so that I can identify students who are truly struggling.
acceptance: Given a student has not logged in and missed sessions, when the system analyzes data, then the student is flagged as struggling.
Given a student has logged in but not updated their build, when the system analyzes data, then the student is flagged as struggling.
Trust: All analysis results are logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Implement data analysis logic that combines login, build, and attendance data to identify struggling students.

stories.title: Flag Students for Instructor Review
stories.narrative: As an instructor, I want the system to flag students for review, so that I can decide on recommendations.
acceptance: Given a student has mixed signals, when the system analyzes data, then the student is flagged for review.
Given a student is flagged for review, when the instructor checks the report, then the student appears with a review flag.
Trust: All flagged students are logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Implement a flagging mechanism for students with mixed data signals.

stories.title: Instructor Review and Approval Interface
stories.narrative: As an instructor, I want to review and approve recommendations, so that I can ensure accuracy before sending.
acceptance: Given a report is generated, when an instructor reviews it, then they can approve or modify recommendations.
Given an instructor approves a recommendation, when the system sends it, then it is marked as approved.
Trust: All instructor actions are logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Develop an interface for instructors to review and approve recommendations before sending.

stories.title: Deliver Reports via Email Platform
stories.narrative: As an instructor, I want to receive weekly reports via email, so that I can review student performance.
acceptance: Given a weekly report is generated, when the report is sent, then the instructor should receive it via email.
Given an invalid email address, when the report is sent, then an error message should be logged.
Trust: All report deliveries must be logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Use the Email Platform API to send reports and log delivery actions in the audit log.

stories.title: Enhance Report with Suggested Messages
stories.narrative: As an instructor, I want the report to include suggested messages, so that I can communicate effectively with students.
acceptance: Given a student is listed in the report, when the report is generated, then it includes a suggested message.
Given a suggested message is inappropriate, when an instructor reviews it, then they can modify it.
Trust: All suggested messages are logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Enhance the report generation module to include suggested messages for each student.

stories.title: Improve User Interface for Report Review
stories.narrative: As an instructor, I want an improved interface for report review, so that I can easily navigate and approve recommendations.
acceptance: Given the interface is loaded, when an instructor navigates it, then it is user-friendly and responsive.
Given an instructor reviews a report, when they approve it, then the interface confirms the action.
Trust: All interface interactions are logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Redesign the report review interface to enhance usability and responsiveness.

stories.title: Handle Incomplete Data Gracefully
stories.narrative: As a developer, I want the system to handle incomplete data, so that it can still generate useful reports.
acceptance: Given data is incomplete, when the system generates a report, then it handles the missing data gracefully.
Given data is incomplete, when an instructor reviews the report, then they are informed of the missing data.
Trust: All instances of incomplete data are logged for audit purposes.
failure_paths: Instructors are not informed of missing data
stories.task_guidance: Implement logic to handle incomplete data during report generation and notify instructors.

stories.title: Optimize System Performance
stories.narrative: As a developer, I want to optimize system performance, so that it responds quickly to user actions.
acceptance: Given the system is under load, when a user performs an action, then the response time does not exceed 5 seconds.
Given the system is optimized, when an instructor uses it, then they experience improved performance.
Trust: All performance metrics are logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Optimize database queries and API calls to improve system performance.

stories.title: Provide Clear Error Messages
stories.narrative: As an instructor, I want clear error messages, so that I can understand and resolve issues quickly.
acceptance: Given an error occurs, when the system displays a message, then it is clear and informative.
Given an error message is displayed, when an instructor follows the guidance, then they can resolve the issue.
Trust: All error messages are logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Develop a comprehensive error messaging system that provides clear guidance to users.

stories.title: Generate Weekly Report with Student Attention List
stories.narrative: As an instructor, I want to receive a weekly report highlighting students who need attention, so that I can provide timely support.
acceptance: Given student performance data, when the weekly report is generated, then it should include a list of students needing attention.
Given no students need attention, when the weekly report is generated, then the list should be empty.
Trust: The generation of the report must be logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Analyze student performance data to identify students needing attention and include them in the weekly report.
